name: Bani
overview: Bani is a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified specifically as the son of Hashabiah. His mention is brief and focused in Nehemiah 11:22, with no additional notes expanding on his role or activities.
namesAndTitles: The name Bani means 'descendant' and is a proper name recorded in Nehemiah 11:22. There is no indication that this name was given directly by God, and its meaning simply reflects lineage or heritage.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Bani as the son of Hashabiah. It is also inferred that Uzzi is his father, providing a generational context within his family. Beyond these, no further family relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Bani's significance lies in his identification as a Levite and a descendant of Hashabiah, which situates him within the priestly tribe during the post-exilic period. His mention in Nehemiah 11:22 highlights the restoration and organization of the Levites in Jerusalem, emphasizing continuity of priestly service. Although not elaborated upon, Bani's inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God's people in reestablishing worship and community after the exile.
